groups.title: A seeded knockout
groups.text:
Sixteen players, seeded 1 to 16, play a knockout tournament: the loser of each match is out. Round 1 has these matches, in this order:

M1: 1 v 16, M2: 8 v 9, M3: 5 v 12, M4: 4 v 13, M5: 3 v 14, M6: 6 v 11, M7: 7 v 10, M8: 2 v 15.

In round 2 the winner of M1 plays the winner of M2, M3's winner plays M4's, M5's plays M6's and M7's plays M8's. In the semi-finals, the two players left from M1 to M4 play each other, and so do the two left from M5 to M8. The two winners meet in the final.

An upset is a match won by the lower-seeded player, the one with the higher number.

questions.text: How many matches are played in the whole tournament?
If seed 4 and seed 9 meet, in which round is it?
Seed 6 won the tournament. What is the least number of upsets there could have been in the whole tournament?
There was exactly one upset in the whole tournament, and it happened in a semi-final. Which of these could have been the final?
